title: Solar array failure
description: The power system has stopped producing electricity. Without it the ship will run down.

options.label: Repair it
options.why: A good repair brings it back to full health; a rushed one leaves it weaker.

options.label: Switch to backup unit
options.why: The spare unit takes over at full health, but it can only be used once.

options.label: Enter safe mode
options.why: It runs in a reduced mode at 40% health, and some science is lost.

options.label: Leave it offline
options.why: Nothing is spent, but the subsystem stays dead.
